parsed.internal_thinking: I am currently at 2 VP with settlements at N14 and N41. My immediate goal is N7 (Brick Port), which I have a road to. I have {Wh:2, B:1, S:2} and need 1 Wood to build the settlement. I just rolled a 7 and blocked Alice's S8 (Hex 4), stealing 1 card from her. I have a hidden Knight card. Since I lack Wood and cannot build or buy anything yet, I will try to trade my surplus Wheat for the Wood I need to settle N7. Alice has a surplus of Wood (3) according to the game state, so she is the primary target despite her recent refusal. If trading fails, I will end my turn and wait for a 3 or 4 roll.
